verdict.rationale: Native tool-calling is documented. Needle takes tools declared via a decorated function, and run() completes the call loop. It returns an empty list when no tool fits, and a decode grammar guarantees parseable output. The Cactus Engine also exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs. Hands-on reports show inconsistent tool selection and weak benchmark accuracy, but the tool calls are produced, so these are quality limits rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: any documented reasoning-parser support, explicit documentation of tool-calling parameters on the OpenAI-compatible serving endpoint, and reliable independent tool-calling accuracy.
